name: Pilgrimage Village Resort & Spa
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Pilgrimage Village Resort & Spa. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Experience world-class service at Pilgrimage Village Resort & SpaPilgrimage Village Resort & Spa is a rustic resort in a tranquil area of Thua Thien Hue. It offers authentic Vietnamese culture and hospitality, extensive spa treatments, and different onsite bars and restaurants. From the property, guests can take the complimentary shuttle bus into Hue. Nearby attractions include tombs of Khai Dinh, Tu Duc and Minh Mang.

At Pilgrimage Village Resort & Spa guests can chose between beautifully furnished bungalows, huts, villas and houses that are all surrounded by natural green forest. Some units include private pools, a plunge pool, gardens, and a variety of free services.

Guests can enjoy attending Vietnamese cooking classes, Tai Chi classes, or select from different tours available. Alternatively, the resort’s swimming pools and the spa offer many ways to relax.

There are 2 restaurants, serving Vietnamese and international cuisine, and 3 bars that include a lounge. Transportation and tour service enquiries can be directed to the front desk and reservations office.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.2 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap

translations.name: Superior Double Room with Local Cuisine Dinner
translations.description:
Welcome to our Superior Room, where sophistication meets serenity. With walls adorned in calming white paint and accents of rich wood and marble stone, this space breathes elegance.

The resort also offers free shuttle bus to and from downtown as the resort's schedule.

We offer 1 complimentary Hue tasting set menu dinner (food only) for 2 persons at our restaurant on the arrival date for guests staying 2 nights under this rate plan only.
Serving time: 18:00 – 22:00 (last order: 21:00).

For guests arriving late, the dinner will be arranged on the second night.

The complimentary dinner is not transferable, redeemable for cash or exchangeable in any other form.

The dinner is always served on the arrival date, except on 31 Dec 2026. If your booking falls on 31 Dec 2026, the complimentary dinner will automatically be arranged on 31 Dec 2026.

If the required minimum number of guests is met, we will replace the set menu dinner with a buffet dinner without prior notice.

name: Spring Garden Villa
description:
You might be eligible for a Genius discount at Spring Garden Villa. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: Spring Garden Villa in Hue offers family rooms with garden views, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes air-conditioning, a work desk, and free WiFi.

Exceptional Facilities: Guests enjoy a lounge, outdoor seating area, and sun terrace. The property provides a shared kitchen, daily housekeeping, and free on-site private parking. Additional services include a tour desk, car hire, and luggage storage.

Delicious Breakfast: A variety of breakfast options are available, including local specialities, vegetarian, vegan, and Asian. Breakfast is served in-room with juice, pancakes, cheese, and fruits.

Convenient Location: Located 15 km from Phu Bai International Airport, Spring Garden Villa is highly rated for its garden, breakfast, and attentive staff.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 8.8 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
